paper_title: Determination of nasal and oropharyngeal microbiomes in a multicenter population-based study – findings from Pretest 1 of the German National Cohort
skip_reason: This is a population-based feasibility study examining swab collection methods (nasal and oropharyngeal) and microbial community characterization in 524 general population participants. It does not compare a disease group against a healthy control group. The study compares swab types and self- vs. staff-collection methods, not disease vs. control populations.
